title: PairRequest
description: Body of POST /pair (docs/protocol.md section 2). The UI mints a one-time code (8 chars, 5-minute TTL, single use); a client exchanges it for a scoped bearer token. Requested scopes are clamped to whatever the code was minted for (the UI chooses when it mints), so the effective scopes/max_action_class in the response may be narrower than requested here.

code.description: One-time pairing code, 8 chars formatted as XXXX-XXXX, 5-minute TTL, single use.

label.description: Human label for the resulting trusted_peers row.

scopes.description: Requested capability globs; clamped server-side to the code's minted scopes.

max_action_class.description: Requested ceiling; clamped server-side to the code's minted ceiling.
